title: Turn a picture into pixel art
description: Scales the picture down so its longer side is size pixels, makes alpha on-or-off, and limits the colours to a palette: a built-in name (pico8, db16, sweetie16, cga, gameboy, 1bit), a palette file (--input palette=<.hex, .gpl or image>), or colors picked from the picture. Writes the sprite at its real size and an enlarged preview. No AI model runs.
